title: MENA Harsh-Climate Industrial Equipment Thermal Derating & ATEX/IP Specification Matrix (40C-55C)
description: Open engineering dataset specifying 40C to 55C ambient thermal derating factors, solar radiation enclosure rules, IP sand-ingress protection, ATEX/IECEx hazardous-area ambient limits, and H2S sour-service metallurgy for power generation and oil/gas equipment in Iraq and Gulf Cooperation Council facilities. Maintained by The Power Contractor (https://pc-cn.com).
